questions.title: Just Say You're Not Home

Waiting for Zach to finish building his house for him

questions.title: Liquidity Problem
questions.prompt: Charlie argued a free beer beat a free laptop. Nathan pointed out that a laptop could be sold for many beers. What was Charlie's decisive counterargument?
options: What if you want a beer right now?
The laptop might only run beer-making software on Windows
Selling it would technically make the beers no longer free
questions.explanation: A laptop can teach you how to make beer. That does not solve the immediate problem of wanting one. Charlie valued time to beer.

receipts.text: IMO a free beer would beat a free laptop
A free laptop can be sold for numerous free beers ☝🏼🤓
With a laptop you can search how to make beer, but what if you want a beer right now? That is why you go with the beer
